About Me

Hi there stranger! My name is Ying Hui, born and raised in 🇲🇾. I have earned my BEng and MSc in Electrical Engineering from the University of Malaya and Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, respectively. Currently, I am a Data Scientist at Singtel in 🇸🇬, collaborating closely with business stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions and integrate analytical models into customer-centric decision engines. Prior to this role, I had the opportunity to serve as an AI Engineer at Lauretta, where I utilised computer vision models to address challenges in security, spatial management, manpower, and behavioral analytics.

Apart from my profession, I enjoy playing video games, reading, cooking and creating art for fun. Drawing inspiration from my favourite author and artist (村上春樹, 宮崎駿), I am on a quest to find my ikigai 生き甲斐, just like them.
